text_simplified: The text discusses the tarbiyah (upbringing) of children and teaching them the fear of Allah and adherence to the religion. It mentions a story about a child who feared his father due to the harshness of his tarbiyah, and emphasizes the importance of balance in tarbiyah between firmness and mercy. It also highlights the necessity of accustoming children to the remembrance of Allah and prayer.
